Following an unspecified reliability issue, Piastri will need to use his fifth Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) of the season, taking him beyond the limit of four that each driver has for the season.

items.originalTitle: Future imperfect: What's behind the abortive 2030 F1 rules announcement?
detailZh: 未来不完美：2030年F1规则宣布失败的背后是什么？
社交媒体上的帖子迅速被删除，暗示已经就下一代F1引擎达成协议
国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆，F1首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利
众所周知，当红衣主教团聚集选举新教皇时，成功的投票结果通过西斯廷教堂烟囱冒出的烟传递给聚集的人群：白烟表示决定，黑烟意味着又要进行一轮投票。这种做法起源于13世纪，当时红衣主教们花了三年时间来辩论克莱门特四世的继任者，激怒了当地信徒，他们把红衣主教们锁在宫殿里，只给他们面包和水维持生命。
当周一备受期待的引擎制造商、国际汽联（FIA）和商业权益所有者之间的会议结束后，21世纪一级方程式（F1）的‘白烟’现象随之而来：国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆（Mohammed Ben Sulayem）在Instagram上发布的一条帖子。
“你们说了，我们听了。V8引擎即将到来，”他在‘资产’下面写道，这是一张带有国际汽联品牌标识的图形，展示了声波，并伴随着高转速V8引擎的清晰咆哮声。
然后，几乎在一眨眼之间，白烟变成了黑色。Instagram帖子，以及国际汽联其他社交媒体渠道上的各种相关公告，都被删除了，只有那些有先见之明截图的人保留了这些内容。
本·苏莱姆（Ben Sulayem）是呼吁回归比当前涡轮增压混合动力V6“更纯粹”的赛车引擎的最积极倡导者之一，他还主张提前进行这一变革。尽管在未来几个赛季中，电力部署与内燃机动力的平衡正在发生变化，但基本概念预计将保持到2031年。
实际上，本·苏莱姆需要FIA、车队、制造商和商业权益持有者之间的共识。协调这些各方——其中一些彼此竞争——通常是一个既痛苦又折磨人的过程。
我们必须在这个背景下看待本周的公告及其随后的记录删除。
从各种简报中可以理解，对于一款带有较小电气元件的2.1升涡轮增压V8发动机，各方达成了广泛的一致。甚至达到这一点也要求做出巨大的妥协，因为本·苏莱姆的口头偏好是自然吸气V8发动机，带有象征性的电气输入，类似于2009年首次出现的动能回收系统（KERS）。
主席认为简化是创造良性循环的方式：制造和开发成本会降低，可能为非制造商的发动机打开道路，而发动机本身也会更轻。这将使汽车达到更低的最低重量成为现实。
这遭到了汽车制造商的相当大的抵制——尽管，为了进一步复杂化辩论，这些制造商并不完全一致。例如，福特和凯迪拉克，由于他们更关注美国市场，据信他们支持取消涡轮增压器，并保留一个较小但仍具重要性的电气元素。在另一端，奥迪和本田认为自然吸气是决定性的因素，并坚持混合动力化的重要元素。
增加两个汽缸的问题要小得多，因为V8发动机在几个关键的道路汽车市场中仍然占据重要地位。在赛车方面，V6发动机由于它们的丑陋点火顺序，即使在不通过强制进气系统（这会降低声音）的情况下，发出的声音也远不如V8发动机那样令人振奋。
虽然涡轮增压的原则很可能会保留，但它将基于较小的压缩机以较低的增压压力运行，这将减少延迟。电动机的输出将从目前的350千瓦（kW）降至一般运行的100kW，另外还有100kW可用于超车。
虽然这是共识，但现在很清楚，周一会议中的几个与会方对实际达成的协议与监管机构有不同的看法。
这并不一定是过程的挫折，尽管它暴露了我们接近必须设定规则的时刻时存在的一些共识不足。所有制造商似乎都同意的一点是，他们需要在年底前获得清晰度，以便有足够的发展空间来迎接2030年的推出。
为此，国际汽联希望在12月10日于上海举行的世界汽车运动理事会会议上提出一个最终的2030年监管框架。然而，这本质上是一个盖章的过程。真正的协议必须在那时之前得到确保。
本周的过早庆祝表明，这个协议已经足够接近，可以撰写新闻稿，但还没有到点击‘发送’的地步。也许我们应该把利益相关者锁在附近的宫殿里，只给他们面包和水，直到达成一致？
detailEn: Future imperfect: What's behind the abortive 2030 F1 rules announcement?
Swiftly deleted social media posts suggested that an agreement had been reached on the next generation of Formula 1 engines
FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem, F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali

Famously, when the papal conclave gathers to elect a new pope, a successful vote is communicated to the huddled masses via smoke from the Sistine Chapel chimney as the chemically impregnated ballot papers are burned: white smoke signifies a decision, black means yet another round of voting. The practice derives from the 13th century, when the cardinals took three years to debate a successor to Clement IV, prompting the frustrated local faithful to lock them inside the palace with only bread and water to subsist upon.

All this came to mind when Monday's much-anticipated meeting between the engine manufacturers, the FIA and the commercial rights holder to discuss the next generation of Formula 1 engines was followed by the 21st century F1 equivalent of white smoke billowing from the chimney: an Instagram post by FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem.
“You spoke, we listened. V8s coming soon,” he wrote underneath the ‘asset', an FIA-branded graphic illustrating sound waves and accompanied by the unmistakeable scream of a high-revving V8 engine.

And then, almost within the blinking of an eye, the white smoke turned black. The Instagram post, along with various related promulgations on the FIA's other social media channels, were deleted, kept for posterity only by those with the foresight to screenshot them.

Ben Sulayem has been among the most vocal exponents not only of a return to ‘purer' racing engines than the current turbocharged hybrid V6s, but also of an earlier timing for that change. Although the balance of electrical deployment to internal combustion engine power is shifting over the next couple of seasons, the essential concept is due to remain in place until 2031.

Realistically, Ben Sulayem requires a consensus between the FIA, the teams, the manufacturers and the commercial rights holder. Aligning these parties – some of whom are in competition with one another – is usually a process that is both tormented and tormenting.
It's in that context we must view this week's announcements and their subsequent striking from the record.

What is understood from various briefings is that there was broad agreement for a turbocharged 2.1-litre V8 with a smaller electrical element. Even to get to this point has required a great deal of compromise, since Ben Sulayem's spoken preference was for naturally aspirated V8s with token electrical input, similar to the Kinetic Energy Recovery System (KERS) first seen in 2009.

The president sees simplification as the way of creating a virtuous circle: manufacturing and development would cost less, potentially opening the way for non-manufacturer engines, while the engines themselves would be lighter. This would make a lower minimum weight for the cars realistically achievable.

This met with considerable resistance from the car manufacturers – although, to complicate the debate further, these are not all aligned with one another. Ford and Cadillac, for instance, with their broader focus on the US market, are understood to have been supportive of dropping turbos and having a smaller but still significant electrical element. At the other end of the scale, Audi and Honda saw natural aspiration as a deal-breaker and were insistent on a strong element of hybridisation.

Adding two cylinders was much less of an issue since V8 engines still figure largely in several key road car markets. In racing terms, V6s make a much less inspiring noise owing to their ugly firing order, even when not breathing via a forced induction system which mutes the soundtrack.

Although the principle of turbocharging will most likely remain, it will be based on smaller compressors running with lower boost pressures, which will reduce lag. The electrical motor's output will be reduced from the current maximum of 350 kilowatts (kW) to 100kW in general running, with another 100kW available to augment overtaking.
While this was the understanding, it's clear now that several of the parties in Monday's meeting emerged with a different perception to the governing body about what had actually been agreed.

This isn't necessarily a setback to the process, even though it has exposed a certain lack of consensus as we approach the point where the rules must be set. One thing all the manufacturers appear to agree on is that they need clarity by the end of this year to have enough development runway for a 2030 introduction.

To that end, the FIA wants to present a definitive 2030 regulatory framework to the World Motor Sport Council meeting in Shanghai on 10 December. This, though, would essentially be a rubber-stamping process. The real agreement must be secured before then.

This week's premature celebration suggests that this agreement is close enough to have the press releases written, but not yet at the point of clicking ‘send'. Perhaps we should lock the stakeholders in a nearby palace and feed them only bread and water until unanimity breaks out?

获胜的竞标者将获得对麦凯轮的“独家访问权”，在2027年F1赛季开始前参观其沃金总部，并有机会见到车队负责人扎克·布朗以及车手诺里斯和皮亚斯特里。
获胜的竞标者还将受邀参加麦凯轮2027赛季的启动活动，包括摩纳哥大奖赛、勒芒24小时耐力赛和印第安纳波利斯500英里赛这一历史性的三冠赛事，并且他们还将获得两次大奖赛的贵宾待遇。

2026年一级方程式赛车的获胜竞标者将在2028年收到赛车，这是由于为了防止竞争对手获取相关知识产权而制定的严格规定。在此期间，他们被提供了一辆2025年的展示车用于展示目的。
2027年一级方程式赛车的获胜竞标者可能也会遇到类似的延迟。

detailEn: McLaren will auction its 2027 MCL41 Formula 1 car with Sotheby’s after the 2026 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
A chassis either used by Lando Norris or Oscar Piastri will be offered complete with a 2027-spec Mercedes power unit in the December 9 auction.

The winning bidder will gain “exclusive access” to McLaren with a tour of its Woking headquarters ahead of the 2027 F1 season, plus the opportunity to meet team principal Zak Brown and drivers Norris and Piastri.

The winning bidder will also be invited to McLaren’s 2027 season launch event, the historic triple crown of the Monaco Grand Prix, the Le Mans 24 Hours, and the Indianapolis 500, plus they will also be given hospitality access at two grands prix.
At the end of the 2025 F1 season, McLaren auctioned the 2026 MCL40A F1 car for $11,480,000 USD, making it the first F1 car to be auctioned before being raced.

The winning bidder of the 2026 F1 car will receive it in 2028 “given the strict regulations conceived to prevent rivals from gaining access to relevant intellectual property”. In the meantime, they were offered a 2025 show car for display purposes.
The winning bidder of the 2027 F1 car might expect a similar delay.
The 2027 McLaren F1 car “may be used in designated demonstration runs and at track days” with a team of McLaren engineers and mechanics accompanying the driver to said events.
McLaren auctioned off its 2027 World Endurance Championship Hypercar for $7,598,750 at last year’s Abu Dhabi auction.
This year’s Abu Dhabi auction includes the Adrian Newey-designed Aston Martin Valkyrie ($2.8m-$3.2m) and a Gordon Murray Automotive T.50 ($5.5m-$6m).

detailZh: “我们没有倒退”——迈凯伦领队解释2026赛季
在连续两年获得车队总冠军后，迈凯伦经历了艰难的一年；领队安德烈亚·斯特拉解释了这一个被意外情况所定义的赛季
迈凯伦的2026年F1赛季以一场始终未能完全兑现的追赶努力为特征。
不过，领队安德烈亚·斯特拉坚持认为，其中的原因已经很清楚，因此他对2027年持乐观态度。他在接受Motorsport.com采访时表示：“与赛季初相比，我们如今处在完全不同的位置。”
每当迈凯伦似乎追上对手时，它发现自己又一次落后了。艰难的开局，随后是逐步的进步，并在赛季中段达到顶峰——当时MCL40似乎有能力树立技术标杆，接着竞争力逐渐下滑，直到巴西大奖赛才重返前列。这条轨迹并不容易解读。
斯特拉的解释超越了单个升级件的性能表现。他将车队2026年的困难追溯到上赛季发生的事情，并指出三个决定性因素：新车研发的延迟、2025年冠军争夺战对车队提出的要求所带来的后果，以及在新规则时代初期作为梅赛德斯客户车队的不利之处。
“我认为本赛季没有任何升级——至少在前排车队中——是不起作用的，”斯特拉解释道。“即使我们在巴库引入了一些新部件，之后看起来我们似乎退步了，但实际情况并非如此。竞争力必须相对于对手来评估，而不能仅仅看自己在绝对意义上的进步。从这个角度来看，我不认为我们在赛季中曾经倒退过。”
这一区分至关重要。迈凯伦在整个赛季中逐步提升，但不足以弥补对手所取得的进步。最重要的是，它必须从最初远超所有人想象的巨大差距中恢复过来。
“我们已确认，在赛季初，我们在研发方面落后了三个月，”斯特拉表示。
这是一个重要的承认，尤其因为这位意大利人明确表示，这不是事后通过将圈速差距换算成数月工作量得出的评估。迈凯伦在分析2025年的研发趋势时就已经发现了这个问题。
斯特拉承认了上赛季冠军争夺期间所发生之事的影响。迈凯伦原本计划逐步将资源转向2026年项目，但红牛在赛季后半程的复苏意味着车队必须继续高度关注仍在赛道上竞争的MCL39。
除此之外，还有一个尤为复杂的管理挑战：既要支持兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的冠军雄心，又要维持内部平衡，不危及车队的未来。
斯特拉表示：“对我来说，这大概是我在F1的26个赛季中工作最努力的一个赛季。每一天，你都必须关注团队环境的管理，以及技术和运营方面的事务。”
这是迈凯伦故事中不太为人所见的方面之一。车队不仅要把精力投入到赛车研发和捍卫竞争力上，还要应对微妙的竞技局势。这项努力再加上技术困难，拖慢了2026年的准备工作。
梅赛德斯包揽双冠表明，如今引擎客户车队要想与供应商车队竞争变得更加困难
然而，斯特拉认为还有第二个决定性因素。多年来，迈凯伦一直证明客户车队可以使用与厂队相同的动力单元赢得世界冠军。2026年，这种情况发生了变化。
斯特拉表示：“2025年，我经常被问到不是厂商车队是否会成为问题。我一直说不会，事实上直到上赛季结束前，这从来都不是问题。”
随着新动力单元的引入，情况变得复杂得多。将引擎整合到赛车中并优化能量管理参数变得至关重要。负责开发具有竞争力且可靠动力单元的梅赛德斯高性能动力系统部门（HPP）必须确立其优先事项。
斯特拉承认：“当你是一支客户车队时，你就不是优先考虑的对象。在理解引擎功率曲线、某些冷却方面或优化整合时，我们来得稍晚了一些。”
一个具体的例子涉及变速箱齿比，这些齿比是根据功率曲线确定的，而这些曲线与随后在赛道上观察到的曲线并不完全匹配。这些看似微小的差异，但在新技术规则下，它们可能转化为显著劣势。
他补充道：“在竞争如此激烈的F1环境中，你不能仅仅因为无法处于研发时机的最前沿，就承受以结构性劣势白白让出零点一秒或零点二秒的代价。”
然而，最敏感的问题涉及用于优化动力单元运行的工具。梅赛德斯高性能动力总成部门（梅赛德斯 HPP）与厂队联合开发的部分软件包含无法与迈凯伦共享的专有元素。
斯特拉说：“他们告诉我们，这些工具包含大量梅赛德斯知识产权，因此不能交给我们。我并没有特别有力的论据去说‘你们无论如何都必须把它们给我们’。”
解决方案是与高性能动力总成部门共同开发等效工具，实质上重复了布拉克利与布里克斯沃思之间已经完成的部分工作。这一过程耗费了时间，迈凯伦要到2027年才能完全获得相同的优化能力。
尽管如此，斯特拉避免对其引擎供应商提出任何批评。他承认HPP面临的困难，包括与可靠性相关的困难，并排除了任何故意让迈凯伦处于不利地位的企图。双方的工作关系一直保持积极，但这并未消除结构性的劣势。
各项研发带来了性能提升，但不足以确保稳定的获胜状态
迈凯伦试图通过整个赛季引入的升级来弥补失去的差距。在迈阿密和匈牙利带来的研发产生了明显的改进，但不足以稳定地缩小差距。
“每次我们带来升级，我们都看到了进步，但我们也看到对手并没有原地踏步。其他车队也带来了自己的升级，我们未能缩小那个差距，”斯特拉承认道。
巴库是一个特别能说明问题的例子。在电能管理至关重要的赛道上，迈凯伦为它在优化动力单元方面的困难付出了代价：“在巴库，我们无法从最后一个弯道一直到最后一段直道末端释放全部电池能量。
“在那一刻，你在这条对动力如此敏感的赛道上承受着关键劣势。”
这些问题在赛季初的几站比赛中就已经显现。在墨尔本，车队发现一个次优参数如何可能影响整场比赛的能量管理，而在中国的可靠性问题导致两辆车都无法起步。
新规则的复杂性此前已被预料到，但没想到会达到这种程度。斯特拉承认，迈凯伦低估了动力单元会变得多么具有决定性，以及每一个未完美校准的参数会带来多高的代价。
不过，2026赛季并未削弱迈凯伦的雄心。斯特拉认为，车队现在对赛车有了更深入的理解，尤其是对梅赛德斯动力单元的理解。
“我对2027年感到乐观，”他说，“与赛季初相比，我们在动力单元的使用方式上已经处于完全不同的境地。”
与HPP的技术关系也将发生变化。2026年初无法使用的工具将在下个赛季完全开放，尽管比梅赛德斯官方车队晚了一年。
斯特拉认为还有另一个重要因素：2026赛季在赛事管理方面的要求低于上赛季，迈凯伦的领导层得以将更多精力投入到技术工作和新车准备上。目标是避免以本赛季拖累车队的同样劣势开启下赛季的冠军争夺。
他说：“我们是一支在三年内发展速度让我们连续两次夺得车队总冠军的车队。我们现在不能退缩，说第三或第四名就足够了。我们的目标是继续成为世界冠军。”
因此，迈凯伦以与赛季初不同的视角结束了2026年。斯特拉没有试图掩盖错误和延误，但他坚持认为全年所做工作的质量是可靠的。
现在的挑战是将车队所学到的转化为竞争优势，并将2026年视为一个过渡年，为未来重返F1前沿奠定基础。
detailEn: "We haven't taken any steps backwards" – McLaren boss explains 2026
It's been a difficult year for McLaren after two consecutive constructors' titles; team principal Andrea Stella explains a season defined by unforeseen circumstances
McLaren's 2026 Formula 1 season has been characterised by a recovery effort that never quite came to fruition.

Yet, team principal Andrea Stella insists the reasons for this are well understood, so he can be optimistic about 2027: "We are in a completely different place compared to the start of the season," he told Motorsport.com.

Whenever it seemed to have caught its rivals, McLaren found itself falling behind once again. A difficult start, followed by progress that culminated in a period of the championship when the MCL40 appeared capable of setting the technical benchmark, then a gradual decline in competitiveness and a return to the front at the Brazilian Grand Prix. This trajectory is not easy to interpret.

Stella has an explanation that goes beyond the performance of individual upgrades. He traces the team's 2026 difficulties back to what happened during the previous season, identifying three decisive factors: a delay in developing the new car, the consequences of the demands placed on the team by the 2025 championship battle, and the disadvantages of being a Mercedes customer team at the beginning of the new regulatory era.

"I don't think there have been any upgrades this season, at least among the top teams, that haven't worked," Stella explained. "Even when we introduced some new parts in Baku, after which it appeared that we had taken a step backwards, that wasn't actually the case. Competitiveness has to be assessed in relation to your rivals, not simply by looking at your own progress in absolute terms. And from that perspective, I don't believe we ever took any steps backwards during the season."

The distinction is fundamental. McLaren improved gradually throughout the season, but not enough to compensate for the progress made by its rivals. Above all, it had to recover from an initial deficit that was considerably greater than anyone might have imagined.
"We established that, at the start of the season, we were three months behind in terms of development," said Stella.

This is a significant admission, particularly because the Italian makes clear that this was not an assessment made retrospectively by translating the gap in lap times into months of work. McLaren had already identified the problem by analysing its development trends during 2025.

Stella acknowledges the impact of what happened during the previous championship battle. McLaren had planned to gradually redirect its resources towards the 2026 project, but Red Bull's resurgence in the second half of the championship meant it had to maintain a strong focus on the MCL39 which was still competing on track.

On top of this came an especially complex management challenge: supporting the championship ambitions of both Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri while maintaining an internal balance that would not jeopardise the team's future.

"For me, it was probably the season in which I worked harder than in any of my 26 seasons in F1," said Stella. "Every day, you had to pay attention to managing the team's environment, as well as the technical and operational aspects."

This is one of the less visible aspects of McLaren's story. The team had to devote its energy not only to developing the car and defending its competitiveness, but also to managing a delicate sporting situation. This effort, combined with the technical difficulties, contributed to slowing preparations for 2026.
Mercedes' double championship demonstrates that it's now more challenging for engine customers to be competitive with their suppliers

There is, however, a second element Stella considers decisive. For years, McLaren had demonstrated that a customer team could win a world championship using the same power unit as a works outfit. In 2026, that situation changed.
"In 2025, I was often asked whether not being a works team was a problem," said Stella. "I always said no, and in fact it had never been a problem until the end of last season."

With the introduction of the new power units, the situation became considerably more complicated. Integrating the engine into the car and optimising energy-management parameters took on decisive importance. Mercedes HPP, tasked with developing a competitive and reliable power unit, had to establish its priorities.

"When you're a customer team, you're not the priority," Stella acknowledged. "When it came to understanding the engine's power curves, certain cooling aspects or optimising the integration, we arrived a little late."

One concrete example involved the gearbox ratios, which had been defined using power curves that did not perfectly match those subsequently observed on track. These might appear to be marginal differences, but under the new technical regulations they can translate into significant disadvantages.

"In such a competitive F1 environment, you cannot afford to give away one or two tenths as a structural disadvantage simply because you're not in a position to be at the cutting edge of development timing," he added.

The most sensitive issue, however, concerns the tools used to optimise the power unit's operation. Some software developed jointly by Mercedes HPP and the works team contained proprietary elements that could not be shared with McLaren.

"They told us that these tools contained a significant amount of Mercedes intellectual property and that they couldn't give them to us," Stella said. "I didn't have particularly strong arguments with which to say, 'You have to give them to us anyway'."

The solution was to develop equivalent tools with HPP, essentially repeating some of the work that had already been carried out between Brackley and Brixworth. This process took time, and it is only in 2027 that McLaren will have full access to the same optimisation capabilities.

Nevertheless, Stella avoids any criticism of his engine provider. He acknowledged the difficulties faced by HPP, including those relating to reliability, and ruled out any deliberate attempt to disadvantage McLaren. The working relationship has remained positive, but that has not eliminated the structural disadvantage.
Developments have added performance, but not enough to ensure consistent winning form

McLaren attempted to make up the lost ground via the upgrades introduced throughout the season. The developments brought to Miami and Hungary produced clear improvements, but they were not enough to close the gap consistently.

"Every time we brought an upgrade, we saw a step forward, but we also saw that our rivals weren't standing still. The other teams brought their own upgrades too, and we weren't able to close that gap," Stella admitted.

Baku is a particularly telling example. At a circuit where electrical energy management is crucial, McLaren paid the price for its difficulties in optimising the power unit: "We weren't able to deploy all the battery energy from the final corner in Baku all the way to the end of the main straight.
"At that point, you're carrying a crucial disadvantage at a circuit that is so sensitive to power."

The problems had already emerged in the opening races. In Melbourne, the team discovered how a single suboptimal parameter could compromise energy management for an entire race, while reliability issues in China prevented both cars from starting.

The complexity of the new regulations had been anticipated, but not to this extent. Stella admits that McLaren underestimated just how decisive the power unit would become and how high the price would be for every parameter that wasn't perfectly calibrated.
The 2026 season hasn't diminished McLaren's ambitions, though. Stella believes the team now has a much deeper understanding of the car and, above all, of the Mercedes power unit.
"I'm optimistic about 2027," he said. "Compared with the start of the season, we're in a completely different place in terms of how we're using the power unit."

The technical relationship with HPP is also set to change. The tools that were unavailable at the start of 2026 will be fully accessible next season, albeit a year later than for the official Mercedes team.

There is another factor that Stella considers important: with 2026 being less demanding in terms of sporting management than the previous season, McLaren's leadership has been able to devote more energy to technical work and preparing the new car. The aim is to avoid starting next year's championship with the same deficit that has hampered the team this season.

"We are a team that, over three years, has had a rate of development that has taken us to two consecutive constructors' championships," he said. "We cannot now back down and say that finishing third or fourth is good enough. Our ambition is to remain world champions."

McLaren therefore ends 2026 with a different perspective from the one it had at the beginning of the season. Stella made no attempt to hide the mistakes and delays, but he stands by the quality of the work carried out throughout the year.

The challenge now is to turn what the team has learned into a competitive advantage, and to look back on 2026 as a transitional year that laid the foundations for a future back at the forefront of F1.

在一次内容广泛的采访中，艾伦·珀曼解释了是什么让利亚姆·劳森在2026赛季表现提升，从而赢得了一份新的F1合同
利亚姆·劳森状态的提升，让小红牛车队无法忽视他征战2027赛季F1的价值。但一如既往，这一表现回升的背后并不只有单一因素。
就在上周，这位24岁的车手才最终确认下赛季继续留在红牛的卫星车队，击退了目前正在争夺F2年度冠军的青训车手尼古拉·措洛夫的竞争。
在接受Motorsport.com采访时，小红牛车队领队艾伦·珀曼解释了为什么选择劳森不必违背车队长期以来的青训车手培养宗旨。
不太明显的是，劳森如何在如此巨大的压力下找回最佳状态，因为他在帮助小红牛车队创纪录地获得制造商锦标赛第五名方面发挥了关键作用，今年为车队贡献了114分中的89分。
劳森在20场大奖赛中15次获得积分，包括目前连续五场进入前九名，这一切都发生在最关键、他的席位压力最大的时候。
“我认为他处理得非常好，”珀曼告诉Motorsport.com。“他能够屏蔽那些噪音。但公平地说，我一直在这整个过程中支持他。”
“我没有跟他说过‘别担心，席位是你的’之类的话，因为在决定做出之前，决定就还没有做出。但他在车队内部一直得到了支持。”
利亚姆·劳森，小红牛车队，艾伦·珀曼，小红牛车队
当被问及劳森进步的根本原因时，珀曼表示，这是学会信任身边团队、磨砺比赛技巧以及收敛他标志性侵略性的综合结果。
“我认为他在各种方面都有进步，”他补充道，“但我认为他的比赛技巧，尤其是第一圈第一个弯，现在非常出色。他很少陷入麻烦，而且经常能提升位置。
他的比赛速度也非常非常好。离开赛车后，他给出的反馈非常清晰，而且带着一种自信。
这种状态会以正确的方式滚雪球：他取得好成绩，离开赛车时更自信一些，这又让他在接下来的周末充满信心，从而再次表现出色。
他带来了惊喜。这是他自己做到的，但当我觉得他需要倾听时，他也听了，并且信任我、车队和他的工程师。这是一种非常健康的比赛方式。
尽管赛季中期他曾作为受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔的替补，为红牛出战了三场比赛，但状态的回升依然发生了。
尽管这段经历让劳森在2025年与主力车队短暂而艰难的两场比赛后（随后被角田裕毅取代）得到了一些了结，但佩尔曼透露，劳森其实更愿意留在原处，继续他在英意车队（小红牛）积累的势头。
“说实话，如果让他选，他并不想去那里，”佩尔曼说。
“这不是针对红牛。不是他不想为他们开车，而是他想继续和我们一起做好正在做的事。我们几乎每天都在讨论伊萨克的手腕，我觉得他回来时是带着一些释然的。
“我们在巴库并不很有竞争力，尽管最终取得了很好的成绩，但之后一切就突然顺畅起来了。”
detailEn: Speed, trust, controlled aggression - What really led to Liam Lawson's career-saving F1 2026
In a wide-ranging interview, Alan Permane has explained what led to Liam Lawson's improved 2026 performances that earned him a new Formula 1 contract
Liam Lawson's improved form made him too good for Racing Bulls to ignore for the 2027 Formula 1 campaign. But, as always, there's more than just a single factor behind that upturn in performances.

It was only last week that the 24-year-old was finally confirmed as staying with Red Bull's satellite team for next season, fending off a challenge by junior driver Nikola Tsolov who is currently vying for the Formula 2 crown.
Speaking to Motorsport.com, Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane explained why a choice for Lawson doesn't have to go against the team's long-running mandate of training young drivers.

What is less obvious is how Lawson managed to find his best form under such immense pressure, as he has played an instrumental role in earning Racing Bulls a record-setting fifth place in the constructors' championship, contributing 89 of the team's 114 points this year.
Lawson has taken 15 points finishes from 20 grands prix, including a current streak of five top nine results, this coming when it mattered the most and pressure on his seat was at its highest.
"I think he's handled himself excellently," Permane told Motorsport.com. "He's just been able to shut that noise out. But in fairness, I've been supporting him throughout all this.
“I haven't been telling him: 'Don't worry, you've got the drive' or anything, because until the decisions are made, the decisions are not made. But he has had support from within the team."
Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls, Alan Permane, Racing Bulls

When asked about the underlying reasons for Lawson's improvements, Permane said it was a combination of learning to trust the team around him, sharpening his race craft and toning down his trademark aggression.

"There's all sorts of areas that I believe he's improved in,” he added, “but I think his race craft, certainly his turn one, lap one is immense now. He rarely gets in trouble and often makes places up.
"His race pace has been very, very good too. Out of the car, he is giving very clear feedback and just has a level of confidence.
"It snowballs in the right way: he has a good result, he's a bit more confident out of the car, and that gives him the confidence going into the following weekend, where he does another great job.

"He's been a revelation. He's done this himself, but he's also listened when I felt he needed to listen and put his trust in me, the team, and his engineers. And that's a really healthy way to go racing."
That upturn in form came despite a three-race mid-season run with Red Bull as a substitute for the injured Isack Hadjar.

Although it gave Lawson some closure after a brutal two-race spell with the main team in 2025 before being replaced by Yuki Tsunoda, Permane revealed Lawson would have rather stayed where he was to continue the momentum he was on with the Anglo-Italian team.
"If I'm being really frank with you, he didn't want to go there if you'd given him the choice," Permane said.

"That's nothing against Red Bull. It's not that he didn't want to drive for them, but he wanted to carry on the good work he was doing with us. We were having almost daily conversations about Isack's wrist, and I think there was some relief coming back.
"We weren't very competitive in Baku despite ending up having a great result, but after that, things just clicked very well."

items.titleZh: F1 V8引擎未来计划进展：FIA与制造商达成初步协议
items.summaryZh: 尽管社交媒体帖子被删除引发疑虑，但F1回归V8引擎的计划正与FIA推进至下一阶段。FIA主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆在Instagram上暗示即将有突破。
items.originalTitle: What’s going on with F1's confusing V8s 2030 future reveal
detailZh: 一级方程式回归V8引擎的计划正在与FIA的协商中稳步推进，尽管周二社交媒体上删除的帖子引起了人们的猜测。
在FIA、FOM和引擎制造商就V8计划进行会议后的第二天，FIA主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆在周二暗示了一个突破。
在一篇发布在Instagram上的帖子中，伴随着V8引擎的声音，本·苏莱姆写道：“你们说了，我们听了。V8引擎即将到来。”
这是由穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆（@mohammed.ben.sulayem）分享的帖子。
这条帖子引起了一些轰动，因为它附带了其他在FIA渠道发布后被删除的社会媒体图形，这些图形指向了一些事情已经确定下来。
这些帖子提到了关于从2030年开始引入V8引擎的原则性协议已经达成。
这些帖子只存在了一段时间，但仍然足够被其他渠道捕捉和分享，并保持在线状态。
不清楚为什么这些帖子出现后又消失了，但一个可能的解释是需要将V8规则流程正式化，在所有各方就绪后，再发布任何官方声明。
这需要决策关键利益相关者的支持，包括国际汽联（FIA）、自由媒体公司（FOM）和制造商。
《赛车》杂志了解到，在周一的会议上，对V8概念达成了广泛的一致意见，该概念将基于2.1升涡轮增压动力单元。
然而，关于整体规则包的许多细节仍需最终确定，制造商对所提议的各个方面并不完全和谐一致——这表明在规则最终确定之前还需要更多的工作。
这方面的讨论预计将继续进行，以期在年底前就广泛达成一致——这是F1和国际汽联公开设定的目标，以概述规则。
下一个重大步骤将是FIA世界汽车运动理事会的下一次会议，该会议将于12月10日在上海举行，以讨论新规则的框架。
一个需要确定的重要问题是V8引擎何时到来。目前的规则计划运行至2031年，但本·苏莱姆一直致力于将新引擎的切换应用于2030年。
为了实现这一点，需要制造商和车队的大力支持，而这只有在有具体的提案供他们投票时才可能实现。
本·苏莱姆最近表示，引入更简单、更便宜的引擎将有助于加速新规则的到来。
“当你让它变得更简单时，你可以将其价格减半。然后如果研发成本减半，加上简单性，生产时间可以更短，”他说。
正如《The Race》所揭示的，2.1升的选择被青睐，因为它是最简单、最便宜的方式，让制造商适应他们当前的V6涡轮增压发动机。
新的动力单元将使用可持续燃料，配备更小的涡轮和降低的增压压力，对电能的依赖性远低于以前。
目前的350kW电动机将降低至200kW，其中只有100kW始终可用。另外100kW将用于超车系统。
随着V8引擎的变革，FIA还计划采取积极的措施来降低F1赛车的重量。目标是将当前赛车的重量减少约80公斤，使其低于700公斤。
detailEn: Formula 1’s plans to return to V8 engines are on track to progress to the next stage with the FIA, despite intrigue over deleted social media posts that appeared on Tuesday.
Just one day after a meeting between the FIA, FOM and engine manufacturers to discuss the V8 plans, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem teased a breakthrough on Tuesday.
In a post that appeared on Instagram and was accompanied by the sound of a V8 engine, Ben Sulayem posted “You spoke, we listened. V8s coming soon.”
A post shared by Mohammed Ben Sulayem (@mohammed.ben.sulayem)
That post created some buzz as it was accompanied by other social media graphics that were published on FIA channels, before being deleted, which pointed to things being set in stone.
These referenced an agreement in principle having been reached for the introduction of V8s from 2030.
These posts were only up for a short time, but that was still long enough for them to be captured and shared by other channels and remain online.

It is not clear why these posts appeared and then disappeared, but one possible explanation is the need to put the V8 rules process on a more formal footing, with all parties lined up, before making any official statements.
This would require support from the key stakeholders in the decision, which includes the FIA, FOM and the manufacturers.
The Race understands that at Monday's gathering there was broad agreement for the V8 concept, which will be based around a 2.1-litre turbo power unit.

However, a lot of the details surrounding the overall rules package still need to be finalised, with manufacturers not in total harmony about every aspect of what is being proposed - which suggests more work is needed before regulations can be finalised.

Discussions on that front are set to continue in a bid to try to get things broadly agreed before the end of this year - which is the timeframe that has been openly targeted by F1 and the FIA to get the rules outlined.
The next big step is set to be the next gathering of the FIA’s World Motor Sport Council, which takes place in Shanghai on December 10, to discuss the framework of the new rules.

One major issue to set in stone is when the V8s will arrive. The current rules are planned to run until 2031, but Ben Sulayem has long targeted the switch to the new engines to come into play for 2030.
For that to happen, it would require the full backing of manufacturers and teams, which could only realistically happen if there are concrete proposals for them to vote on.
Speaking recently, Ben Sulayem suggested that getting simpler and cheaper engines in play would open the door for fast-tracking the arrival of the new rules.
"When you make it simpler, you can make it half of the price. Then if the R&D goes down by half, with the simplicity, the production time can be shorter,” he said.
As revealed by The Race, the 2.1-litre choice has been favoured because it is the simplest and cheapest way for manufacturers to adapt their current V6 turbos.
The new power units will run on sustainable fuels with a smaller turbo with reduced boost pressure, and have a far lesser reliance on electrical power.
The current 350kW electric motor is set to decrease to 200kW, with only 100kW available all of the time. The other 100kW will be used for an overtake system.

As well as the changes in power units coming with the V8s, the FIA also plans an aggressive push to bring the weight of F1 cars down. Sights are set on reducing the current car mass by around 80kg, which could get them below 700kg.

detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫回忆安东内利少年时住在其家中的温馨往事
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫分享了一段温馨故事：少年时期的基米·安东内利曾住在他家，并在沙发上睡着
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
众所周知，F1围场竞争残酷无情，但梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫在管理车手培养体系时，却带着一种鲜明的家长式作风。在引导基米·安东内利从青训卡丁车梯队一路走到他历史性的2026年世界冠军之后，沃尔夫最近透露了这位20岁车手究竟有多深地融入了他的实际家庭。
在最近接受德国媒体《图片报》的独家采访时，沃尔夫被要求分享他对这位年轻明星最美好的个人回忆。
沃尔夫没有指向某场具体比赛或某个卡丁车冠军头衔，而是回忆起安东内利在他英国家中居住的那段时光。
“两三年前，他在布拉克利工厂时总是睡在我们家，”沃尔夫解释道。
因为安东内利当时只有17岁，而且要在梅赛德斯的模拟器和工程部门度过漫长而艰苦的日子，沃尔夫觉得自己对他的健康负有个人责任。
“毕竟他还是未成年人；我们不能只是把他安置在酒店里，”沃尔夫指出。“这就是为什么他几乎成了苏西和我[家]的常客。”
与一位身价数十亿美元的赛车运动运营首席执行官同住，自然带来了一些独特的家庭休闲时光。沃尔夫分享说，三人经常在晚上坐下来一起看电影，以缓解工厂工作的压力，但观影聚会很少按计划进行。
“晚上我们经常一起看电影——尽管实际上只有我一个人在看，”沃尔夫开玩笑说。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
据沃尔夫说，他的妻子、F1学院董事总经理苏茜·沃尔夫以看电影不到10分钟就睡着而闻名。由于安东内利在布拉克利工厂高强度工作数日后也精疲力竭，两人会立刻在沙发上昏睡过去。
“然后他们俩肩并肩睡着了，我一个人看完了电影，”沃尔夫深情地回忆道。
如今，距离他在老板沙发上睡着不过短短几年，安东内利已成为F1历史上最年轻的车手世界冠军——这充分证明沃尔夫亲力亲为的培养策略完全奏效。
detailEn: Toto Wolff reveals heartwarming memory of a teenage Kimi Antonelli living at his house
Mercedes boss Toto Wolff shares a heartwarming story about a teenage Kimi Antonelli living at his house and falling asleep on the couch
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Formula 1 paddock is notoriously cutthroat, but Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff operates his driver management pipeline with a distinctly paternal approach. After guiding Kimi Antonelli from the junior karting ranks all the way to his historic 2026 world championship, Wolff recently shed light on just how deeply the 20-year-old is integrated into his actual family.
In a recent exclusive interview with the German publication BILD, Wolff was asked to share his most beautiful personal memory of the young star.
Rather than pointing to a specific race or a karting championship, Wolff recalled the time Antonelli spent living at his house in the United Kingdom.
"Two or three years ago, he always slept at our house when he was at the factory in Brackley," Wolff explained.

Because Antonelli was only 17 years old at the time and spending long, gruelling days working in the Mercedes simulator and engineering departments, Wolff felt a personal responsibility for his well-being.
"He was still a minor, after all; we couldn't have just put him in a hotel," Wolff noted. "That's why he was practically a regular guest at Susie's and my [house]."

Living with the CEO of a multi-billion-dollar motorsport operation naturally led to some unique family downtime. Wolff shared that the trio would frequently sit down in the evenings to watch movies together to decompress from the factory work, but the viewing parties rarely went as planned.
"In the evenings we often watched films together - although it was really just me," Wolff joked.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

According to Wolff, his wife, F1 Academy managing director Susie Wolff, is notorious for falling asleep within the first 10 minutes of a movie. Because Antonelli was also completely drained from his intense days working at the Brackley facility, the two would immediately pass out on the couch.
"Then they both fell asleep shoulder to shoulder, and I watched the film alone," Wolff fondly recalled.

Now, just a few short years after crashing on his boss's couch, Antonelli stands as the youngest drivers' world champion in F1 history - proving Wolff's personal, hands-on development strategy has paid off in full.

“奥斯卡（皮亚斯特里）因可靠性问题将在拉斯维加斯使用新的内燃机，”车队在赛事前瞻中表示。“由于这是他本赛季第五台内燃机，他将接受罚退10位的处罚，但他在周六的正赛中很有机会通过超车收复位置。”
迈凯伦还确认将采用梅赛德斯升级版涡轮增压器，该部件由制造商在国际汽联所谓的ADUO追赶机制下研发。
“与其他HPP动力单元赛车一样，两辆赛车都将配备新的符合ADUO规格的涡轮增压器：预期的性能提升相对较小，”迈凯伦指出。
梅赛德斯厂队将在新加冕的世界冠军基米·安东内利的赛车上试用新款涡轮，而乔治·拉塞尔将继续使用原有规格以避免发车位罚退，因为拉塞尔已经达到了其允许的限额。
“从本周末起，我们将提供辅助动力单元开发机会启用的涡轮规格，”梅赛德斯F1负责人托托·沃尔夫表示。“这主要是为了在比赛周末条件下验证开发成果，预期的性能提升相对较小。”
“我们预计在基米（安东内利）的赛车上使用它，而对于乔治（拉塞尔），我们的首要任务是保护他的发车位，因为性能提升可能太有限，不足以证明接受发车位罚退是合理的。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri set for grid penalty at F1 Las Vegas GP
Australian McLaren driver will lose 10 places on the grid as McLaren decides to take a fresh Mercedes engine
McLaren driver Oscar Piastri is set for a 10-place grid drop at F1's Las Vegas GP for exceeding his engine allowance for the season.
Piastri was already on the limit of four internal combustion engines for the year, but will need a fifth Mercedes V6 engine to finish the 2026 season.
As it is the first time he is exceeding his ICE allowance, the Australian will be docked 10 places on Las Vegas' starting grid.

"Oscar will take a new Internal Combustion Engine in Las Vegas after a reliability issue," the team said in its event preview. "As it is his fifth of the season, he will take a 10-place grid penalty, but he has a good chance to recover positions with overtaking in Saturday's race."
McLaren also confirmed it will take Mercedes' upgraded turbocharger, which the manufacturer developed under the FIA's so-called ADUO catch-up mechanism.
"Both cars, as with the other HPP-powered cars, will be fitted with a new ADUO-enabled turbo specification: the expected performance benefit is relatively small," McLaren noted.

The Mercedes works team will trial the new turbo on newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli's car, while George Russell will stay on the original specification to avoid a grid drop, as Russell had already reached the limit of his allowance.

"We will have the ADUO enabled turbo specification available from this weekend," said Mercedes F1 chief Toto Wolff. "This is primarily about proving out the development in race-weekend conditions, with the expected performance benefit relatively small.
"We anticipate running it with Kimi, whilst with George our priority is protecting his grid position with the performance benefit likely too limited to justify taking a grid penalty."
